text:
Leah M: Heads-up: noticed ~140 summit_eu leads dropped into UNASSIGNED between 09:30-11:00 CET. Sales ops is flagging SLA misses.
Diego S: Oof. Is this the RR service or the HubSpot webhook?
Leah M: Webhook payloads look normal; RR responded with assigned: null. sample attached below.
Nina K: Can you paste the RR response?
Leah M: ```
{"lead":"LD-998","assigned":null,"meta":{"slot":7}}
```
Owen R: Quick skim of the rotation algorithm shows a dependence on (timestamp / 3600) % team_size to advance pointer. That makes assignment change if timestamps are in CET vs UTC around DST.
Diego S: That sounds like a timezone seeding bug. We had maintenance that restarted services around midnight CET yesterday.
Nina K: Business impact: VIP leads have 2m claim SLA, standard 5m. Right now ~20 VIPs are unclaimed >10m. Need mitigation.
Owen R: Short-term mitigation plan: set explicit fallback_owner for the summit form to "EMEA SDR Pool" and force RR to use deterministic increment (last_index + 1) mod N. Also add a canary (10% traffic).
Leah M: Can we do that now? Sales Ops wants owner mapping fixed immediately.
Diego S: I'll update the routing map and notify Sales Ops. Nina, can you change HubSpot workflow to route to fallback_owner when owner is null?
Nina K: On it. Also increasing claim timeout for summit form from 120s -> 300s while we fix.
routing-bot: deploy-check: branch=hotfix/rr-tz-seed, ci=green, smoke=ok
Owen R: I'll patch RR code to remove timezone-dependent math and add unit tests asserting deterministic rotation ignoring tz.
Leah M: After canary (15m) if no null assignments, promote to 100%. If unassigned_count > 5 for 15m, rollback to fallback-only and escalate to Execs.
Diego S: Sales Ops notified. I've added a brief note to the handoff playbook and pinged @sales-ops.
Nina K: Patch applied: fallback_owner set, claim timeout increased, HubSpot rule updated. Adding heartbeat alert to #marketing-leads every 10m for unassigned count.
Owen R: Canary looks clean (0 nulls in 10m sample). Preparing full rollout now.
Leah M: Thanks team. Please file a short incident note for QBR with root cause = timezone-dependent rotation seeding and remediation steps. :thumbsup:
